# Off The Muscle Pressure Cleaning

> Family-owned, licensed and insured pressure washing company based in West Palm Beach, Florida, serving all of Palm Beach County plus Northern Broward and Southern Martin counties. Owner-led on every job. Rated 5.0 on Google (47 reviews).

Phone: 561-698-8537 (call or text)
Email: info@offthemuscle.net
Address: 3200 Summit Blvd, West Palm Beach, FL
Hours: Monday to Sunday, 7am to 7pm
Website: https://www.offthemuscle.net

## Services

- [Residential Power Washing](https://www.offthemuscle.net/services/residential-power-washing): whole-home soft washing that removes algae and mildew from stucco, siding, and trim without damaging paint.
- [Driveway & Surface Cleaning](https://www.offthemuscle.net/services/driveway-surface-cleaning): driveways, sidewalks, pool decks, patios, and pavers surface-cleaned to an even, stripe-free finish.
- [Roof Cleaning](https://www.offthemuscle.net/services/roof-cleaning): low-pressure soft wash roof cleaning for tile, shingle, and metal roofs.
- [Commercial Power Washing](https://www.offthemuscle.net/services/commercial-power-washing): storefronts, plazas, gas stations, HOAs, and office buildings, including recurring maintenance programs.

## Service area

West Palm Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, Jupiter, Wellington, Royal Palm Beach, Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Boynton Beach, Lake Worth, Loxahatchee, Stuart, Hobe Sound, Jupiter Island, Palm City, Deerfield Beach, Coral Springs, Pompano Beach, Parkland.

## Facts

- Free estimates, most sent the same day.
- Licensed and insured; certificate of insurance available on request.
- 10% discount for police, fire, EMS, and active military with valid credentials.
- Soft washing is used on houses, roofs, and screens; pressure washing on concrete and pavers.
